autonomous_job.objective: Start EIRA2 transport V8 as the new single-owner transport, then retire legacy V6/V7 transport owners after a short delayed handoff without interrupting Superprobe or EIRA runtime.
autonomous_job.canary_candidate_text:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations
import json, os, signal, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('/media/domenicleonetti/easystore/EIRA/LIVE').resolve()
V8=ROOT/'eira_probe'/'transport_runtime_v8'/'EIRA2_AUTONOMOUS_TRANSPORT_V8.py'
LOG=ROOT/'eira_probe'/'transport_runtime_v8'/'transport_v8.log'
STATE=ROOT/'eira_probe'/'transport_runtime_v8'/'process.json'
if not V8.is_file(): raise SystemExit('transport_v8_missing')
legacy=[]
for p in Path('/proc').iterdir():
    if not p.name.isdigit(): continue
    try: cmd=(p/'cmdline').read_bytes().replace(b'\x00',b' ').decode(errors='replace')
    except Exception: continue
    if 'EIRA2_AUTONOMOUS_TRANSPORT_V6.py' in cmd or 'EIRA2_AUTONOMOUS_TRANSPORT_V7.py' in cmd: legacy.append(int(p.name))
LOG.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
with LOG.open('ab',buffering=0) as log:
    proc=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,str(V8),'--root',str(ROOT),'--interval','2'],cwd=str(ROOT),stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True,env={**os.environ,'EIRA_LIVE_ROOT':str(ROOT),'PYTHONPATH':str(ROOT)})
reaper='import os,signal,time; time.sleep(12); pids='+repr(legacy)+'; [(os.kill(p,signal.SIGTERM) if p!=os.getpid() else None) for p in pids if os.path.exists(f\'/proc/{p}\')]'
subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c',reaper],cwd=str(ROOT),stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,start_new_session=True)
payload={'schema':'eira2_transport_v8_handoff_v1','ok':True,'pid':proc.pid,'legacy_pids':legacy,'handoff_delay_seconds':12,'started_unix':time.time(),'v8':str(V8),'log':str(LOG)}
tmp=STATE.with_name(STATE.name+f'.tmp.{os.getpid()}'); tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n'); os.replace(tmp,STATE)
print(json.dumps(payload,sort_keys=True))
